svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · two packs beside the Meridian set (docs/design/cursor-concept.svg) · same 12 roles and hotspots on the 24-unit grid · drawn by the desktop, the same in every app
Installed · reference: Light (white body, near-black outline) and Dark
New · for readability: 1.5x larger, 2 px heavy outline, pure black and white; same shapes, no translucency
New · filled in the accent with a white rim and a soft shadow, rounded joins; follows the accent and the light/dark mode
Every pack keeps the 12 roles and their hotspots, so
switching never moves where a click lands.
Recovery and the login screen keep Meridian Light,
whatever is chosen, so a pointer is always readable.
Contrast ignores transparency and the accent.
Comet re-tints when the accent changes, without
Requires: a pack and a size in the cursor setting (today: light or dark), cursor images per pack at 24/32/48 px in the desktop. Values are illustrative.
